correctness.rationale: Adjacency in the canonical word is controlled by the later bit. One-runs give the true-twin classes, except that the initial vertex joins the first such class iff a₁=1. A separating zero distinguishes different one-runs. For n≥3 only vertices of the final zero-run can be leaves, and they are leaves iff the final one-run has length one; K₂ has (s,t)=(1,1). The first, middle and last allowed block-pair classes give U,V,W, with V(0)=0. Separating the four singleton-pair cases yields R, then the geometric series yields the coefficientwise count. Siblingless words begin 00, end 1 and avoid 11, giving the Fibonacci recurrence; leafless words end 11, leaving n−3 free bits. The four order-four words 0001,0011,0101,0111 give (0,3),(1,0),(1,1),(3,0), while orders two and three are symmetric. This verifies the universal claims by proof; the separate bounded reproduction check_threshold_words.py also checked every word through n=12 and 539 cumulative coefficients. The supplied verification.py was not executed.
